summary: Tests-only red-phase run for issue #5. Added permanent offline unit tests that pin the generated OpenAPI client contract (module ColorMatchingOpenAPI; six upstream operations; operation IDs; request paths; response enums including .undocumented) via a recording ClientTransport, plus BearerTokenMiddleware auth behavior. Added inspectable contract-delta documentation derived from the published spec sources (viamin/color_matching main: lib/color_matching_web/api_schemas.ex, controllers, router). No Swift toolchain exists in this container, so swift test could not be executed locally; the new tests intentionally fail to compile here (missing generated module) as the expected red-phase signal, and the macOS CI runner is the executor of record.

acceptance_criteria.description: swift-openapi-generator + swift-openapi-runtime added to the iOS package; OpenAPI document vendored from viamin/color_matching#110
acceptance_criteria.reason: Implementation-phase work blocked for this tests-only run by the phase rules; the new tests import ColorMatchingOpenAPI and OpenAPIRuntime, so package wiring is required for the test target to compile. No Swift toolchain in container to execute.

acceptance_criteria.description: Client generated for the surfaces the app uses: manifest, recent sheets, capture creation, measurement upload, judgment upload, ranked results
acceptance_criteria.reason: One stubbed generated-client test per operation is defined (getManifest, listRecentSheets, getRankedResults, createCapture, uploadMeasurements, uploadJudgments), but the generated client does not exist yet (red phase) and no Swift toolchain is available locally.

acceptance_criteria.description: Replace hand-written API models with generated types; keep purely client-side models
acceptance_criteria.reason: Model replacement is implementation-phase; the tests construct only generated wire types (Components.Schemas.*) and the plan pins MeasurementCore.SheetManifest etc. as intentionally hand-written (spec gap G-1).

acceptance_criteria.description: Swift tests exercising the generated client against local stubbed responses (no live server in CI)
acceptance_criteria.reason: Tests are written entirely against a local RecordingClientTransport stub (no network), but could not be executed: swift is not installed in this container. Executor of record: swift test --disable-sandbox on the macOS CI runner (.github/workflows/ci.yml).

acceptance_criteria.description: PR description records deltas between the prose contract and the published spec, and endpoint gaps discovered
acceptance_criteria.reason: Delta document was written by inspecting the published spec sources on viamin/color_matching main (api_schemas.ex, test_sheet_controller.ex, capture_controller.ex, router.ex, api_spec.ex, and open_api_spex operationId derivation); it enumerates 9 deltas and 5 endpoint gaps and is the verbatim source for the PR body.

acceptance_criteria.description: Server-side drift becomes visible as a regeneration diff / compile error instead of a runtime surprise
acceptance_criteria.reason: Drift-sensitive assertions are in place (exact upstream operation IDs, request paths/methods, schemaVersion enums, .undocumented case for undocumented status codes, and documented-absent measurement-upload fields), but they cannot run until the implementation run wires the generated client.
